description: Multi-hop cross-chain forensic trace for a wallet address. Auto-detects bridge solvers (NEAR Intents, Wormhole, deBridge, Stargate, Across, Synapse, Hop), follows relay chains across chains, and returns a graph of nodes (solver / relay / user / exchange / bridge) and edges with on-chain tx signatures plus same_intent_correlation. Source chain: EVM chains (including Kaia) or Solana. Price: $0.50 per request.

address.description: Wallet address to start the trace from

max_depth.description: Max BFS hops (1-4, default: 3). Higher = deeper trace but slower.

name: bridge_flow_trace
